Enabled.label: Enable Meltype
Enabled.description: Turn the IME and keyboard input on or off.

JapaneseKeyboardOnly.label: Only while the Windows input language is Japanese
JapaneseKeyboardOnly.description: Suspend Meltype while the Windows input language is English or another language, and resume when it returns to Japanese.

AllowInjectedInput.label: Accept injected input
AllowInjectedInput.description: Also handle keys sent by remote desktop, VNC, and key-layout tools. Turn this off if another tool's keys should pass through unchanged.

Mode.label: Input mode
Mode.description: Tsf: use Meltype as a Windows IME (select it with Win+Space). Keyboard: use Meltype's own conversion box (typing English stays English; Space converts and Enter commits).

ToggleShortcuts.label: Input-mode toggle keys
ToggleShortcuts.description: Register one or more shortcuts that switch between Japanese and English input. Avoid shortcuts already used by Windows or other applications.

ConvertKeysSwitchKeyboard.label: Henkan to English / Muhenkan to Japanese
ConvertKeysSwitchKeyboard.description: In keyboard mode, when no conversion box is open, Henkan switches to English and Muhenkan switches to Japanese input.

AltKeysSwitchKeyboard.label: Left Alt to English / Right Alt to Japanese
AltKeysSwitchKeyboard.description: Pressing Left Alt alone switches to English and Right Alt alone switches to Japanese. Alt+Tab and Alt+click are not affected.

AutoCorrectAfterCommit.label: Correct after the surrounding text
AutoCorrectAfterCommit.description: If a word such as i or sushi is committed as one reading, commit it again automatically once the following word makes English or Japanese clear.

DirectModeAutoDetect.label: Detect romaji in English mode
DirectModeAutoDetect.description: In English mode, detect when you start typing a romaji word and switch back to Japanese input automatically.

SigilWordsDirect.label: Pass / $ @ at the start as typed
SigilWordsDirect.description: In keyboard mode, a line beginning with /, $, or @ is passed to the application without conversion so agent commands and file mentions work.

SnippetMark.label: Snippet trigger
SnippetMark.description: In keyboard mode, type this mark and a snippet name, then Space or Tab, to insert a registered snippet. Esc returns to the typed text.

SpaceAroundEnglish.label: Half-width spaces around English
SpaceAroundEnglish.description: Insert half-width spaces between Japanese and English words when committing. Numbers and URLs without Japanese context are left alone.

SpaceAroundNumbers.label: Half-width spaces around numbers
SpaceAroundNumbers.description: Insert half-width spaces between Japanese and half-width numbers when committing.

NumberKeysSelectCandidates.label: Number keys select candidates
NumberKeysSelectCandidates.description: While converting, the top-row 1-9 keys select the numbered candidate. Numpad keys always select candidates.

ShiftSpaceHalfWidth.label: Shift+Space enters a half-width space
ShiftSpaceHalfWidth.description: During Japanese input, Shift+Space inserts a half-width space instead of a full-width space.

EnterCommitsAsShown.label: Enter commits what is shown
EnterCommitsAsShown.description: Enter commits the text currently shown without applying typo correction. Space conversion still corrects typos.

AlphanumericKeyStartsAsTyped.label: First F9/F10 press keeps the typed case
AlphanumericKeyStartsAsTyped.description: The first F9 or F10 press keeps the visible English as typed; later presses cycle all-uppercase, capitalized, and lowercase.

FullWidthParentheses.label: Full-width parentheses
FullWidthParentheses.description: Convert ( ) typed during Japanese input to （ ）.

FullWidthSlash.label: Full-width slash for Japanese
FullWidthSlash.description: Convert / typed after kana to ／ instead of ・.

SquareBrackets.label: Full-width square brackets
SquareBrackets.description: Convert [ ] typed during Japanese input to ［ ］ instead of 「 」.

EscStepsBack.label: Esc steps back
EscStepsBack.description: Esc undoes one step of the current input instead of clearing everything.

EscRevertsSelectedClause.label: Esc in conversion restores the selected clause
EscRevertsSelectedClause.description: While converting, Esc restores the selected clause to kana instead of cancelling the whole conversion.

FunctionKeysAffectSelectedClause.label: F6-F10 affect only the selected clause
FunctionKeysAffectSelectedClause.description: When converting multiple clauses, F6-F10 change only the selected clause instead of the whole text.

CompatibleShortcuts.label: Ctrl+K / L resize the clause
CompatibleShortcuts.description: Ctrl+K shortens and Ctrl+L lengthens the selected clause during conversion.

PartialCommit.label: Shift+Enter commits up to the selected clause
PartialCommit.description: Commit the selected clause and keep the remaining clauses in kana for further editing.

MacControlKeys.label: macOS-style Control shortcuts
MacControlKeys.description: Use Control+J/K/L for hiragana/katakana/full-width English and other macOS-style editing shortcuts.

CursorIntoBrackets.label: Move the caret inside brackets
CursorIntoBrackets.description: After committing a bracket pair, place the caret inside it when the application supports caret movement.

ControlKeyBindings.label: Control key bindings
ControlKeyBindings.description: Bind Control plus a letter to another key, for example T=F6;Y=F7;U=F8;I=F9;O=F10.

CalculatorCandidates.label: Calculator results as candidates
CalculatorCandidates.description: When converting an expression containing only numbers and + - * / ( ), show the result and "expression=result" as candidates.

LogKeyIntervals.label: Log key intervals (diagnostic)
LogKeyIntervals.description: Record the interval between keys in the diagnostic log. Only timing is recorded, not the text.

LaughterAfterKana.label: Single-kana + w becomes laughter
LaughterAfterKana.description: Convert a single kana followed by w (for example なるほどw) to laughter instead of the English word new.

ContextualLearning.label: Learn English and Japanese separately
ContextualLearning.description: Remember whether an ambiguous word was chosen in an English or Japanese context and apply that choice in the same context.

FullWidthSpaceByDefault.label: Full-width space by default
FullWidthSpaceByDefault.description: Space inserts a full-width space during Japanese input; Shift+Space inserts a half-width space.

ShowCandidatesWhileTyping.label: Show conversion candidates while typing
ShowCandidatesWhileTyping.description: Show up to five conversion candidates before Space is pressed.

GitHubIssueCandidates.label: GitHub Issue/PR titles for #numbers
GitHubIssueCandidates.description: Convert #123 to the title of the matching GitHub issue or pull request in the configured repository.

GitHubRepository.label: GitHub repository
GitHubRepository.description: Repository queried for #number candidates, written as owner/name.

ClipboardCandidates.label: Clipboard text as a candidate
ClipboardCandidates.description: Show one line of clipboard text (up to 200 characters) when converting a clipboard reading. Windows only.

PauseHotkey.label: Pause/resume hotkey
PauseHotkey.description: Shortcut that pauses and resumes Meltype. Changes take effect after restarting Meltype.

Punctuation.label: Punctuation style
Punctuation.description: Choose the comma and period used when typing , and . during Japanese input.

JapanesePunctuationAfterEnglish.label: Japanese punctuation after English
JapanesePunctuationAfterEnglish.description: Convert a comma or period typed after an English word to the Japanese punctuation style.

LiveConversion.label: Live conversion
LiveConversion.description: In keyboard mode, convert and display kana as you type, before Space is pressed.

ConversionEngine.label: Conversion engine
ConversionEngine.description: Engine used for kana-kanji conversion. Hybrid prefers Mozc and falls back to Microsoft IME.

UseZenzai.label: Use Zenzai (Windows, experimental)
UseZenzai.description: Use the Zenzai neural kana-kanji conversion model with a separately installed llama-server and GGUF model.

ZenzaiServerPath.label: Zenzai: llama-server path
ZenzaiServerPath.description: Path to llama-server used when Zenzai is enabled.

ZenzaiModelPath.label: Zenzai: GGUF model path
ZenzaiModelPath.description: Path to the zenz GGUF model used when Zenzai is enabled.

TranslationCandidates.label: English translation candidates
TranslationCandidates.description: Show English translations after the Japanese conversion candidates.

PredictiveCandidates.label: Predictive candidates
PredictiveCandidates.description: Show continuation candidates while typing. Choose with Tab/Shift+Tab and commit with Enter.

EnglishNamePredictions.label: English company/service predictions
EnglishNamePredictions.description: When predictive candidates are on, also suggest English company and service names from the reading.

TabConversion.label: Tab starts conversion
TabConversion.description: Tab starts conversion like Space. Inside a conversion, Tab selects the next candidate and Shift+Tab the previous one.

ContinueAfterConversion.label: Keep typing after conversion
ContinueAfterConversion.description: Do not commit when typing after opening a conversion; keep the typed character in the conversion box.

SeparateKeyRoles.label: Separate key roles while typing
SeparateKeyRoles.description: Give Space, Henkan, Muhenkan, and Kana keys distinct roles inside the conversion box.

EnglishFirstInput.label: English-first input
EnglishFirstInput.description: Keep typed English as English; use the conversion key or Down to convert it as romaji.

ConsonantAbbreviations.label: Consonant abbreviation candidates
ConsonantAbbreviations.description: Show candidates for consonant-only readings such as ast or Angt.

ShowCandidateMeanings.label: Show candidate meanings
ShowCandidateMeanings.description: Show a meaning or translation after the candidate list when hovering or pausing on a candidate.

ShowTypedKeys.label: Show typed keys
ShowTypedKeys.description: Show the keys typed so far under the conversion box or candidate list.

CorrectTypos.label: Correct typos
CorrectTypos.description: Correct obvious romaji or English typos when converting or committing.

SlashAsMiddleDot.label: / enters a middle dot after kana
SlashAsMiddleDot.description: Convert / typed after kana to ・. URLs and fractions are kept as /.

ZSymbols.label: z + symbol keys enter symbols
ZSymbols.description: In Japanese input, z followed by h/j/k/l or punctuation enters symbols such as brackets and quotes.

ShowModeIndicator.label: Show input mode near the caret
ShowModeIndicator.description: Show あ (Japanese) or A (English) near the caret when the input mode changes.

ShowModeIndicatorOnFocus.label: Show the mode on focus too
ShowModeIndicatorOnFocus.description: Also show the mode indicator when the caret enters an input field.

ModeIndicatorJapaneseColor.label: Mode indicator color: Japanese (あ)
ModeIndicatorJapaneseColor.description: Background color for the あ indicator in #RRGGBB form.

ModeIndicatorDirectColor.label: Mode indicator color: English (A)
ModeIndicatorDirectColor.description: Background color for the A indicator in #RRGGBB form.

ModeIndicatorTextColor.label: Mode indicator text color
ModeIndicatorTextColor.description: Text color for the あ/A indicator in #RRGGBB form.

CompositionPlacement.label: Conversion box position
CompositionPlacement.description: Overlay: draw the preedit in place. Below caret / Above caret: use a separate box.

CompositionSize.label: Conversion box text size
CompositionSize.description: Auto follows the input field font size; choose Small to Huge to override it.

CompositionFont.label: Conversion box font
CompositionFont.description: Font used in the conversion box.

CompositionTheme.label: Conversion box colors
CompositionTheme.description: Dark, Light, or follow the Windows theme.

CompositionOpacity.label: Conversion box opacity
CompositionOpacity.description: Make the conversion box translucent so the text behind it remains visible.

ShowNotifications.label: Show notifications
ShowNotifications.description: Show Windows notifications when Meltype is enabled, paused, or needs attention.

AutoUpdate.label: Update automatically
AutoUpdate.description: Check for and download new versions automatically; install on the next restart or from the tray.

InputStyle.label: Input style
InputStyle.description: Romaji input or JIS kana input.

DetectionLevel.label: Detection strength
DetectionLevel.description: Aggressive, Balanced, Conservative, or Manual Japanese/English boundary detection.

ScoredSegmentation.label: Choose boundaries by score (experimental)
ScoredSegmentation.description: Score possible English/Japanese boundaries and choose the most natural one.

JapaneseThreshold.label: Japanese decision threshold
JapaneseThreshold.description: Switch to Japanese when the Japanese score is at least this value; higher values make detection stricter.

TypoEnabled.label: Use typo detection
TypoEnabled.description: Add a small Japanese score when a key sequence looks like a typo.

MaxPendingKeys.label: Maximum pending keys
MaxPendingKeys.description: Maximum number of characters held while deciding English or Japanese. The text is output as-is if the limit is reached.

LearningEnabled.label: Enable user learning
LearningEnabled.description: Remember chosen conversions, language choices, and predictions. Turning this off keeps existing learning.

ImeTimeoutMs.label: IME timeout (ms)
ImeTimeoutMs.description: Time to wait for the converter before showing the current text.

PasteApps.label: Apps that accept pasted input
PasteApps.description: Commit one character at a time by paste for the listed processes.

NoPasteApps.label: Apps that do not accept pasted input
NoPasteApps.description: For these processes, avoid clipboard paste and send keys one at a time.

TextInputApps.label: Apps treated as text fields
TextInputApps.description: Treat focus in these processes as an editable text field even when the accessibility tree does not report one.

ExcludeFullscreen.label: Ignore fullscreen apps
ExcludeFullscreen.description: Do not hold keys in fullscreen windows such as games and video players.

StopInGames.label: Stop in games
StopInGames.description: Do not run in windows detected as games from known game folders.

AppRules.label: Per-application settings
AppRules.description: Set on/off and a kind for each process name. Code mode keeps code English and only converts comments and strings.

AppKinds.label: Custom app kinds
AppKinds.description: Define custom kinds used by per-application settings, such as code-like behavior.

FileLog.label: Write a log file
FileLog.description: Write diagnostics to meltype.log. Typed text is included only when LogTypedText is on.

LogTypedText.label: Include typed text in the log
LogTypedText.description: Include committed text, typed English, readings, and candidates in the log for diagnostics.

UiLanguage.label: Settings language
UiLanguage.description: Language used by the settings window. Auto follows the system language.

AiModel.label: AI model
AiModel.description: Choose None, Zenz, Jinen, kanakanji-edge, or shuntelligence. Installation and paths are shown only for the selected model.

DisableZShortcuts.label: Disable z symbol shortcuts
DisableZShortcuts.description: Disable symbol input such as z. z/ and zh.

NumpadDirect.label: Commit numpad input directly
NumpadDirect.description: Commit numpad digits and operators directly; the current text is committed first. Windows only.

MuhenkanKatakanaCycle.label: Cycle katakana with Muhenkan
MuhenkanKatakanaCycle.description: Cycle full-width katakana, half-width katakana, and hiragana with the Muhenkan key while typing.

StartConversionAtLastClause.label: Start conversion at the last clause
StartConversionAtLastClause.description: When conversion starts with Space or Tab, select the last clause instead of the first. Useful when editing a long sentence from the end.

TimeZone.label: Time zone
TimeZone.description: Time zone used for the current time shown by "とけい" and "じこく". Example: Asia/Tokyo, UTC, America/New_York.

PrereleaseUpdate.label: Include pre-releases in automatic updates
PrereleaseUpdate.description: Automatic update checks include pre-release versions as well as stable releases. Off by default.

NowPlayingCandidates.label: Offer the now-playing song for "なう"
NowPlayingCandidates.description: When converting "なう", offer the title and artist of the song playing in Windows. If nothing is playing, show the time as before. Typed text is not sent.

ui.判定テスト (ローマ字か英語かの判定。英字で入力):: Detection test (romaji or English; type letters):
ui.編集可能な通常入力欄のみ対応。OS辞書・確定後訂正・学習保存は使用しません。: Editable text fields only. OS dictionary, post-commit correction, and learning are not used.
